info.title: Talyn API
info.description: Start and drive Talyn sessions from code. Authenticate with a personal access token. See docs/PUBLIC_API.md for the guides.

bearerAuth.description: A personal access token (`talyn_pat_...`) from Settings → Developer in the Talyn app.

param.description: The request field the error is about, when there is one.

error.description: Some errors carry more fields, e.g. `limit` and `in_use` on a plan limit.

workspace_ids.description: The workspaces this token can reach. Null: all of them.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page. Null on the last page.
Pass as `cursor` for the next page. Null on the last page.

queued_message_count.description: Messages waiting for the running turn to end.

thread_id.description: The thread this session belongs to, if any.

runtime.description: A `local` session runs in the desktop app. The API lists it read-only; actions on it answer 409 `local_runtime`.

diff_stat.description: Null until a diff has been computed once.

chats.description: The open chats, oldest first. On single-session responses only.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page. Null on the last page.

workspace_id.description: Required unless the token is bound to exactly one workspace.

kind.description: Default `session`. A thread takes no repository or branch.

prompt.description: The first message. The agent starts on it when the sandbox is ready.

name.description: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Default: made from the prompt.

branch.description: An existing branch to work on. Default: a new branch.

pull_request_id.description: Start from this pull request's head branch and link the session to it.

thread_id.description: Put the new session in this thread.

queued.description: True: the message waits behind a running turn or for the sandbox. False: the turn started now.

seq.description: Position in the chat. Gap-free and increasing.

data.description: The agent event, in Claude Code's stream-json format. Codex output is converted to the same format. New fields can appear.

has_more.description: More events exist in the direction you paged.

last_seq.description: Pass as `after` for the next page forward.

status.description: Where the entry is: `queued`, `awaiting_ci`, `awaiting_review`, `automerge_armed`, `awaiting_external`, `awaiting_stack`, `fixing`, `merging`, `blocked` or `blocked_manual`. New values can appear.

position.description: 1-based place in the queue of its repository and base branch.

head_sha.description: The head the queue last saw. Null before it has seen one.

blocked_code.description: Why a `blocked` or `blocked_manual` entry is parked, e.g. `draft`, `no_progress`, `awaiting_human_check`. New values can appear.

blocked_reason.description: The same reason, in words for a person.

auto_merge_armed.description: GitHub's own auto-merge is armed on the pull request.

external_state.description: The state an external merge queue (trunk.io) reports, when one owns the base branch.

MergeQueueState.description: The pull request's entry in Talyn's merge queue. Null when it is not queued.

open_count.description: Open findings at or above the workspace reporting bar.

stale_for_head.description: The pull request has new commits since the findings were made.

CodeReviewSummary.description: The latest code review. Null: never reviewed. On single responses only.

title.description: Null until Talyn has read the pull request from GitHub once. So are the other GitHub fields.

authored.description: You opened it. The "Mine" bucket in the app.

review_requested.description: It waits for your review. The "Review" bucket in the app.

review_hidden_at.description: When you hid it from the Reviews tab.

ci_status.description: The CI picture alone. `failing_required` includes a failing check whose required-ness is not known. `needs_human`: only gates a person must clear are failing. Null: not computed yet.

human_gates.description: Failing gates only a person can clear, e.g. a visual review.

blocking_reason.description: The whole merge verdict: `mergeable`, `merge_conflicts`, `changes_requested`, `checks_failed`, `checks_failed_optional`, `blocked`, `behind`, `needs_human`, ... New values can appear.

review_decision.description: `approved`, `changes_requested` or `review_required`, as the app shows it. Where the base branch does not require reviews, Talyn works it out from the reviews.

auto_keep_mergeable.description: Talyn starts a fix when the pull request stops being mergeable.

opened_at.description: When the pull request was opened on GitHub.

last_synced_at.description: When Talyn last read the pull request from GitHub.

created_at.description: When Talyn started to track it. Lists are ordered by this.

session_ids.description: Sessions that work on this pull request and are not archived, most recent first. On single responses only.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page. Null on the last page.

body.description: The description as Talyn last read it. Null: not read yet.

prompt.description: The first message. The agent starts on it when the sandbox is ready.

name.description: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Default: made from the prompt.

has_more.description: Always false: the queue is one page.

method.description: How to merge. Default: the last method used for this pull request, else `squash`.

data.description: Newest first. At most the newest 100.

anchor_verified.description: The quoted code is at the place the finding names. False: the reviewer paraphrased or named the wrong place.

lenses.description: The reviewers that reported it. Two or more is agreement.

verdict_reason.description: The judge's reason, in one sentence.

status.description: `selected`: a fix run works on it now. `stale`: a later review did not find it again. New values can appear.

seen_count.description: How many review cycles reported it.

carried_over.description: An earlier cycle reported it first.

posted_at.description: When it was posted to the pull request. A posted finding is never posted again.

suggestion.description: A suggested change, as plain text. Single finding only.

anchor.description: The code the finding quotes. Single finding only.

cycle.description: How many times this pull request has been reviewed. Each new review is a new cycle of the same review.

phase.description: `queued`, `preparing`, `reviewing`, `sweeping`, `validating`: in progress. `ready`, `failed`, `cancelled`, `fixing`, `fixed`, `idle`: at rest. New values can appear.

phase_plan.description: The phases this cycle goes through, in order.

lenses_run.description: The reviewers that ran in this cycle.

head_sha.description: The commit the current cycle reads.

reviewed_head_sha.description: The commit the findings belong to.

stale_for_head.description: The pull request has new commits since the findings were made.

open_count.description: Open findings at or above the workspace reporting bar. The number the app shows.

funnel.description: What the review did with its candidates: raised, kept by the judge, thrown out.

deferred_since.description: Set while a reviewer waits for a free runner.

findings.description: Most severe first. Without `body`, `suggestion` and `anchor`. On `GET /code-reviews/{id}` only.

data.description: A pull request has at most one review. It holds every cycle.

preset.description: How deep to review. Default: the workspace setting.

reset.description: Throw away the findings on record instead of carrying them forward.

data.description: Newest first. At most the newest 200.

posted.description: Findings written to the pull request.

inline.description: Of those, comments on a line of the diff.

in_summary.description: Of those, in the review body.

finding_ids.description: The findings to post. Empty or absent: every open finding not posted yet.

get.summary: Get the token and its owner
get.description:
Returns the token that made the request: its scopes, its workspace binding and its expiry, and the account it acts for.

Any valid token.

get.description:
Forward with `after` (oldest first; poll with the returned `last_seq`), or backward with `before` (`latest`, or a `seq`), which returns whole turns. Poll no more than once a second; to follow a running turn, use the stream.

Scope: `sessions:read`.

schema.description: Events with a greater `seq`, oldest first. Default 0.
`latest` for the newest page, or a `seq` for the page before it. Returned oldest first, whole turns only.
Events per page, 1 to 2000. Default 500.

get.description:
Server-sent events. Each `transcript` frame is one event, with `id:` set to its `seq`. On connect the stream sends the stored events after `after` (or after the `Last-Event-ID` header), then new events as they arrive. `chat` frames carry the chat when its status changes. An `end` frame closes the stream when the chat is closed or the session is archived or deleted. A comment line (`: ping`) every 15 seconds keeps the connection open.

Scope: `sessions:read`.

schema.description: Start after this `seq`. The `Last-Event-ID` header wins when both are sent.

post.summary: Read a pull request from GitHub again
post.description:
Fetches the pull request from GitHub now and stores it. A pull request that is no longer open gets its closed or merged state. Uses your GitHub rate limit, so it has its own, lower limit (see rate limits). Answers 409 `cannot_refresh` when GitHub does not have it.

Scope: `pull_requests:write`.

post.summary: Add a pull request to the merge queue
post.description:
Talyn merges it when it is clean, and starts a fix run when it has conflicts or failing checks. Adding a pull request that is already queued changes only its `method`. The free plan holds 3 queued pull requests: over that, the answer is 402 `merge_queue_limit_reached`.

Scope: `pull_requests:write`.

post.description:
Writes the findings to the pull request as one GitHub review from your account, always as a comment (never approve or request changes). A finding goes on a line of the diff only when its quoted code was found there; the others go in the review body. A finding is never posted twice. 409 `code_review_post_not_ready` or `code_review_post_nothing_to_post`; 502 `code_review_post_github_failed` when GitHub refuses.

Scope: `code_reviews:write`.
